pairs.target: dìwǔshíbā tiān , luò héng bǎ dèngzǐ bān dào tǎ wéi pángbiān , zuò dé hěn jìn .
pairs.english: On day fifty-eight, Lohen moved his stool close beside Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 第五十八天，洛衡把凳子搬到塔维旁边，坐得很近。

pairs.target: tā shì láikàn de . qiántiān shuō guò dehuà , tǎ wéi méi wàng , shènzhì zǎofàn shí hái xiǎng guò , yàoshi jīntiān liúxià dé bǐ shàngcì jiǔ yìdiǎn , jiù néng ràng tā shuō qīng dàodǐ kànjiàn le shénme .
pairs.english: He had come to watch. Tavi remembered his promise two days ago; over breakfast he had imagined a longer hold today, so Lohen could explain exactly what he saw.
pairs.hanzi: 他是来看的。前天说过的话，塔维没忘，甚至早饭时还想过，要是今天留下得比上次久一点，就能让他说清到底看见了什么。

pairs.target: yàngpiàn réng shì nà yíduì . wéi lǎoshī kànguò jiēchùmiàn , zhǔn tā àn yuánlái de fúdù shì , bù jiā zhòngliàng .
pairs.english: The samples were the same pair. Instructor Vey checked the contact faces and permitted the original change, without added weight.
pairs.hanzi: 样片仍是那一对。维老师看过接触面，准他按原来的幅度试，不加重量。

pairs.target: luò héng zuòzài cèmiàn , mǐlā dú lìngyìbiān , shuí yě méiyǒu cuī . dìyīcì sōngshǒu , liǎngbiān lìkè huíqù le .
pairs.english: Lohen sat to one side, Mira read the other, and no one hurried him. On the first release, both sides returned immediately.
pairs.hanzi:
洛衡坐在侧面，米拉读另一边，谁也没有催。
第一次松手，两边立刻回去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ jìlù tuī jìn , děng le yíhuìer cái shì dìèrcì . zhèhuí liǎngshǒu líkāi dé hěn qí , tóngkuài què háishì méiyǒu tíng .
pairs.english: Tavi drew the record closer and waited before a second try. His hands lifted evenly, but the weights still did not pause.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把记录推近，等了一会儿才试第二次。这回两手离开得很齐，铜块却还是没有停。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào bùnéng zài zuò dìsāncì , shǒu fàng huí xī shàng , yǎnjīng què bùkěn cóng xìshéng shàngyí kāi .
pairs.english: He knew there would be no third try. His hands returned to his knees; his eyes would not leave the thin cords.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道不能再做第三次，手放回膝上，眼睛却不肯从细绳上移开。

pairs.target: luò héng qīng shēn kàn le kàn zhǐ , wèn qiántiān shìbushì yě zhème kuài . " búshì . " tǎ wéi dá dé tài xiǎng .
pairs.english: Lohen leaned toward the paper and asked if it had been so quick two days ago. “No,” Tavi answered too loudly.
pairs.hanzi:
洛衡倾身看了看纸，问前天是不是也这么快。
“不是。”塔维答得太响。

pairs.target: mǐlā táiqǐ tóu . tā liǎnshàng fārè , xiǎng shuō lǎoshī yě kànjiàn le , xiǎng bǎ nàtiān de yíqiè dōu bān dào jīntiān zhè zhāng zhuōzi shàng .
pairs.english: Mira looked up. His face warmed; he wanted to say the teacher had seen it, to move everything from that day onto today's table.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抬起头。他脸上发热，想说老师也看见了，想把那天的一切都搬到今天这张桌子上。

pairs.target: kě luò héng zhǐshì zài wèn , bìng méiyǒu shuō tā sāhuǎng . " yǒu yìxiǎo huìer . " tā yòu shuō , " jīntiān méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: But Lohen was only asking, not accusing him of lying. “There was a moment,” he added. “Not today.”
pairs.hanzi:
可洛衡只是在问，并没有说他撒谎。
“有一小会儿。”他又说，“今天没有。”

pairs.target: luò héng diǎndiǎntóu , zài zìjǐ de zhǐ shàng tiān le yìháng . tǎ wéi yǐwéi nà shàngmiàn xiě de shì méi zuòchéng , piē guòqù , què kànjiàn tā huà le liǎnggè shǒuzhǎng , pángbiān yǒu yìgēn wāiwāi de jiàntóu .
pairs.english: Lohen nodded and added a line to his paper. Tavi expected “failed,” but saw two drawn palms and a crooked arrow.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡点点头，在自己的纸上添了一行。塔维以为那上面写的是没做成，瞥过去，却看见他画了两个手掌，旁边有一根歪歪的箭头。

pairs.target: " nǐ zài huà shénme ? " " wǒ zìjǐ de shǒu . wǒ de zuǒbiān zǒng bǐ yòubiān zǎo zǒu . "
pairs.english: “What are you drawing?” “My own hands. My left always leaves before the right.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你在画什么？”
“我自己的手。我的左边总比右边早走。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnguò lái , nà zhī zuǒshǒu shǎo huà le yìgēn zhǐtou . mǐlā kàn le yìyǎn , wèn shìbushì yīncǐ zǒudékuài . luò héng nábǐ bǔ shàng , méi rěnzhù xiào .
pairs.english: He turned the sheet around; the left hand lacked a finger. Mira asked if that made it quicker. Lohen drew it in, unable to keep from smiling.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸转过来，那只左手少画了一根指头。米拉看了一眼，问是不是因此走得快。洛衡拿笔补上，没忍住笑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào le , xīnlǐ nà diǎn jǐnbēng què méiyǒu quán sōng . tā shōu yàngpiàn shí , réng bǎ hégài kòu dé hěn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled too, but did not entirely relax. He still snapped the box lid loudly when putting the samples away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也笑了，心里那点紧绷却没有全松。他收样片时，仍把盒盖扣得很响。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ méiyǒu xiǎo kè . pà wò zài yuànzi lǐ dǎqiú , jiàn tā yán qiáng zǒu , táishǒu jiù bǎ qiú rēng guòlái .
pairs.english: There was no small-group class that afternoon. Seeing him by the wall, Pavo tossed him the ball from the courtyard game.
pairs.hanzi: 下午没有小课。帕沃在院子里打球，见他沿墙走，抬手就把球扔过来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiē dé cāngcù , qiú cā guò zhǐjiān , luò jìn qiángbiān de kōng kuāng . " hǎo zhǔn ! " pà wò hǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi fumbled; the ball grazed his fingers and fell into an empty basket. “Great aim!” Pavo called.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维接得仓促，球擦过指尖，落进墙边的空筐。
“好准！”帕沃喊。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi xiǎng wǎng nàér rēng . " " nà jiù bié gàosù tāmen . "
pairs.english: “I didn't mean to throw it there.” “Then don't tell them.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我没想往那儿扔。”
“那就别告诉他们。”

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ liǎngzhī jiù kuāng bǎizài yuànzi liǎngtóu , jiè dìshàng de zhuān fèng huàjiè .
pairs.english: They put two old baskets at opposite ends of the yard and used brick joints as boundaries.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把两只旧筐摆在院子两头，借地上的砖缝划界。

pairs.target: sìgè rén yìbiān , qiú luòdì biàn huànrén , bùnéng bào zhe pǎo guò sāntiáo fèng . tǎ wéi yǐqián kànguò , zhēnzhèng jìnqù wán háishì tóuyìhuí .
pairs.english: Four on each side; a dropped ball changed possession. No carrying it across more than three joints. Tavi had watched before but never played.
pairs.hanzi: 四个人一边，球落地便换人，不能抱着跑过三条缝。塔维以前看过，真正进去玩还是头一回。

pairs.target: luò héng yě zài , bèi pà wò jiào dào lìngyìbiān . tā tuō xià wàiyī , bǎ xiùzǐ dié dé zhěngzhěngqíqí , fàngzài chuāngtáishàng . tǎ wéi jiàn tā zhèyàng , hūrán hěn xiǎng yíng .
pairs.english: Lohen was there too, on the other side. He removed his coat, folded the sleeves neatly and laid it on the sill. Seeing that, Tavi suddenly wanted to win.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡也在，被帕沃叫到另一边。他脱下外衣，把袖子叠得整整齐齐，放在窗台上。塔维见他这样，忽然很想赢。

pairs.target: kāitóu tā pǎo dé tài kuài , qiú hái méi chuánlái , rén yǐjīng dào le duìmiàn de kuāng páng . pà wò jiào tā huílái , tā biàn yǐwéi zìjǐ dǎng le lù , tuì dé gèng yuǎn .
pairs.english: At first he ran too fast, reaching the far basket before the pass. Pavo called him back; thinking he blocked the way, he retreated even farther.
pairs.hanzi: 开头他跑得太快，球还没传来，人已经到了对面的筐旁。帕沃叫他回来，他便以为自己挡了路，退得更远。

pairs.target: lún dào duìfāng chuánqiú , luò héng dǎo méiyǒu pǎo , zhī zài zhōngjiān zhàn zhe , děng lìng yígè rén rào dào tā shēnhòu , cái bǎ qiú cóng jiān biān sòngchūqù .
pairs.english: On the opponents' turn, Lohen stood in the middle and waited until another player circled behind him, then sent the ball past his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到对方传球，洛衡倒没有跑，只在中间站着，等另一个人绕到他身后，才把球从肩边送出去。

pairs.target: qiú jìn le kuāng . yǒurén duòjiǎo , yángqǐ yìquān xì huī . tǎ wéi xiǎng xué nà yíxià .
pairs.english: The ball landed in the basket. Someone stamped, raising fine dust. Tavi wanted to try that move.
pairs.hanzi:
球进了筐。有人跺脚，扬起一圈细灰。
塔维想学那一下。

pairs.target: xià yìhuí jiēdào qiú , tā zhuāngzuò wǎng zuǒ kàn , yòushǒu wǎnghòu pāo , què wàng le pà wò yǐjīng pǎo dào qiánmiàn .
pairs.english: Next time, he feigned looking left and threw backwards with his right hand, forgetting Pavo had run ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 下一回接到球，他装作往左看，右手往后抛，却忘了帕沃已经跑到前面。

pairs.target: qiúyuèguò suǒyǒurén , zá zài luò héng diéhǎo de yīfu shàng , gǔnxiàlái shí tuō chū yìzhī xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: It flew over everyone, hit Lohen's folded coat and dragged a sleeve down as it rolled off.
pairs.hanzi: 球越过所有人，砸在洛衡叠好的衣服上，滚下来时拖出一只袖子。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ jìng le yíxià , suíjí yǒurén xiào chū le shēng . tǎ wéi pǎo qù jiǎn , pāidiào huī , bǎ yīfu chóngxīn fàng hǎo .
pairs.english: The yard went briefly quiet, then someone laughed. Tavi ran to retrieve it, brushed off dust and replaced the coat.
pairs.hanzi:
院里静了一下，随即有人笑出了声。
塔维跑去捡，拍掉灰，把衣服重新放好。

pairs.target: luò héng guòlái kàn le yìyǎn , méi shuō shénme , tǎ wéi fǎndǎo gèng nánshòu . " búshì chōng nǐ . " tā shuō . " wǒ zhīdào . chōng wǒ jiù rēng dé tài yuǎn le . "
pairs.english: Lohen came to look and said nothing, which made Tavi feel worse. “I wasn't aiming at you.” “I know. Far too long if you were.”
pairs.hanzi:
洛衡过来看了一眼，没说什么，塔维反倒更难受。
“不是冲你。”他说。
“我知道。冲我就扔得太远了。”

pairs.target: pà wò zài hòumiàn hǎn , wèn tāmen shìbushì yào xiān bǎ yīfu xǐwán zài huílái .
pairs.english: Pavo shouted behind them: were they going to wash the coat before coming back?
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃在后面喊，问他们是不是要先把衣服洗完再回来。

pairs.target: luò héng bǎ wàiyī guàdào gāo yìdiǎn de gōuzǐ shàng , pāipāi tǎ wéi de jiān , shuō huànbiān , tā qù gěi tǎ wéi nà duì shǒu kuāng .
pairs.english: Lohen hung the coat higher, patted Tavi's shoulder and said they would change sides: he would guard Tavi's basket.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡把外衣挂到高一点的钩子上，拍拍塔维的肩，说换边，他去给塔维那队守筐。

pairs.target: hòumiàn jǐlún , tǎ wéi zhōngyú xuéhuì děng . děng búshì zhànzhebúdòng , shì kàn duìyǒu yào wǎng nǎlǐ qù .
pairs.english: In the following rounds Tavi learned to wait: not stand still, but watch where teammates wanted to go.
pairs.hanzi: 后面几轮，塔维终于学会等。等不是站着不动，是看队友要往哪里去。

pairs.target: yǒu yìhuí tā míngmíng néng tóu , què kànjiàn pà wò shēn qián kōng zhe , biàn bǎ qiú chuán guòqù .
pairs.english: Once he could shoot but saw space in front of Pavo and passed instead.
pairs.hanzi: 有一回他明明能投，却看见帕沃身前空着，便把球传过去。

pairs.target: pà wò jiē zhù , zhuǎnshēn , déyì dé tài zǎo , shǒu yì huá , qiú zhuàng zhe kuāng yán tánchūlái .
pairs.english: Pavo caught it, turned and gloated too soon. His hand slipped; the ball hit the rim and bounced out.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃接住，转身，得意得太早，手一滑，球撞着筐沿弹出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān mà le yìshēng , yòu xiào dé wān xiàyāo . " nǐ gāngcái nàme shénqì ! " " kuāng dòng le . " " kuāng yǒu jiǎo ? "
pairs.english: Tavi cursed, then doubled over laughing. “You looked so pleased!” “The basket moved.” “Has it got feet?”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维先骂了一声，又笑得弯下腰。
“你刚才那么神气！”
“筐动了。”
“筐有脚？”

pairs.target: pà wò zìjǐ yě xiào , zhuī zhe qiú pǎo yuǎn . méi rén yào bǎ gāngcái nà yì tóu cóng jìlù lǐ cādiào , yīnwèi tāmen zǎoyǐ shǔbùqīng nǎbiān duō jìn le jǐgè .
pairs.english: Pavo laughed too and chased the ball. No one wanted that throw erased from the score; they had lost count anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃自己也笑，追着球跑远。没人要把刚才那一投从记录里擦掉，因为他们早已数不清哪边多进了几个。

pairs.target: rìguāng tuì dào yuànqiáng shàng shí , luò héng shuō dé zǒu le , tā háiyǒu bànzhāng biǎo méichāo wán . tǎ wéi yě xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ de jìlù , yíxià ānjìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: As sunlight retreated up the wall, Lohen said he must leave: half a form remained to copy. Tavi remembered his own records and fell quiet.
pairs.hanzi: 日光退到院墙上时，洛衡说得走了，他还有半张表没抄完。塔维也想起自己的记录，一下安静下来。

pairs.target: liǎng rén qù shuǐcáo biān xǐshǒu . shuǐ chōngdiào huī , lùchū zhǐfèng lǐ yuánlái de yánsè .
pairs.english: They washed at the trough. Water removed dust, revealing the colour between their fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 两人去水槽边洗手。水冲掉灰，露出指缝里原来的颜色。

pairs.target: luò héng wèn xià yícì hái néng bunéng láikàn , tǎ wéi dīng zhe liúshuǐ , wèn tā búpà yòu bái zuò yìtángkè ma .
pairs.english: Lohen asked to watch next time too. Staring at the water, Tavi asked if he feared another wasted lesson.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡问下一次还能不能来看，塔维盯着流水，问他不怕又白坐一堂课吗。

pairs.target: " wǒ zìjǐ yě yǒu zuò bù chūlái de shíhòu . " tǎ wéi nǐnggān bù , méiyǒu mǎshàng dāying .
pairs.english: “I fail sometimes too.” Tavi wrung out the cloth without agreeing at once.
pairs.hanzi:
“我自己也有做不出来的时候。”
塔维拧干布，没有马上答应。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng zài xǔxià yìchǎng gěi biérén kàn de chénggōng , zuìhòu zhī shuō , lǎoshī zhǔn dehuà , jiù lái . " xíng . " luò héng shuō .
pairs.english: He did not want to promise another performance of success. At last he said, if the teacher allowed it, come. “All right,” Lohen said.
pairs.hanzi:
他不想再许下一场给别人看的成功，最后只说，老师准的话，就来。
“行。”洛衡说。

pairs.target: huídào qǐnshì , tǎ wéi dǎkāi hézi jiǎnchá , quèrèn gàizi méiyǒu bèi zìjǐ kòu liè .
pairs.english: Back in the dormitory, Tavi checked that he had not cracked the lid by snapping it shut.
pairs.hanzi: 回到寝室，塔维打开盒子检查，确认盖子没有被自己扣裂。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā fàngzài zhuōshàng , ràng pà wò bǎ gǔn guòlái de qiú ná yuǎn yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He set the box on the table and asked Pavo to take the rolling ball farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 他把它放在桌上，让帕沃把滚过来的球拿远一点。

pairs.target: pà wò shuōhǎo , xià yíkè yòu wèn , míngtiān tā hái lái bu lái . tǎ wéi xiǎng le xiǎng , shuōlái , bié zàishuō kuāng huì dòng .
pairs.english: Pavo agreed, then asked if he would play tomorrow. Tavi thought a moment: yes, but no more claims of moving baskets.
pairs.hanzi:
帕沃说好，下一刻又问，明天他还来不来。
塔维想了想，说来，别再说筐会动。
